progression.narrative: The performance opens on F#3 and dwells most on F# in Naghmeh-e Maghlub. The line peaks at A#4 (467.5 Hz) at 0:14.3. It closes on F#4, not the tonic (A#4 → Ek4 → Gs4 → Gs4 → A#4 → F#4).
